83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {
89:       top: { value: new THREE.Color(top) },
90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
108: }

110: function sporeField(count, color, radius, height, size) {
111:   const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
112:   const seeds = []
113:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
114:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
115:     const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * radius
116:     const y = Math.random() * height
117:     positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
118:     positions[i * 3 + 1] = y
119:     positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
120:     seeds.push({ speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35, phase: Math.random() * 10, a })
121:   }
122:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
123:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
124:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color, size, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true })
125:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
126:   points.userData.seeds = seeds
127:   return points
128: }

130: function mushroom(x, z, scale, hue) {
131:   const g = new THREE.Group()
132:   const stemMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#c9d8bd', roughness: 0.8 })
133:   const capMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: hue, emissive: hue, emissiveIntensity: 0.5, roughness: 0.5 })
134:   const stem = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06 * scale, 0.1 * scale, 0.6 * scale, 6), stemMat)
135:   stem.position.y = 0.3 * scale
136:   stem.castShadow = true
137:   g.add(stem)
138:   const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.26 * scale, 10, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2), capMat)
139:   cap.position.y = 0.6 * scale
140:   cap.scale.y = 0.6
141:   cap.castShadow = true
142:   g.add(cap)
143:   const dotMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#f4ffe0' })
144:   for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
145:     const dot = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.028 * scale, 5, 4), dotMat)
146:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
147:     dot.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.16 * scale, 0.62 * scale + Math.random() * 0.05 * scale, Math.sin(a) * 0.16 * scale)
148:     g.add(dot)
149:   }
150:   g.position.set(x, 0, z)
151:   g.rotation.y = Math.random() * Math.PI
152:   return g
153: }

295: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
296:   let sum = 0
297:   for (const gene of GENES) {
298:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
299:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
300:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
301:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
302:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
303:   }
304:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
305: }

307: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
308:   const child = {}
309:   const mutations = []
310:   for (const gene of GENES) {
311:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
312:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
313:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
314:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
315:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
316:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
317:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
318:       mutations.push(gene.key)
319:     }
320:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
321:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
322:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
323:     }
324:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
325:   }
326:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
327: }

70:     }
71:     x.globalAlpha = 0.3
72:     x.strokeStyle = '#ffcf7a'
73:     for (let r = 70; r < 250; r += 60) {
74:       x.beginPath(); x.arc(256, 256, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); x.stroke()

83: function skyMesh(top, horizon, bottom) {
84:   const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(90, 24, 16)
85:   const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
86:     side: THREE.BackSide,
87:     depthWrite: false,
88:     uniforms: {
89:       top: { value: new THREE.Color(top) },
90:       horizon: { value: new THREE.Color(horizon) },
91:       bottom: { value: new THREE.Color(bottom) },
92:     },
93:     vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
94:     fragmentShader: `
95:       varying vec3 vP; uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 bottom;
96:       float hash(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,45.164)))*43758.5453); }
97:       void main(){
98:         vec3 d = normalize(vP);
99:         float h = d.y;
100:         vec3 col = mix(horizon, top, smoothstep(0.02, 0.65, h));
101:         col = mix(bottom, col, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.03, h));
102:         float star = step(0.9975, hash(floor(d*420.0))) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, h);
103:         col += vec3(0.55,0.9,0.8) * star * 0.85;
104:         gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
105:       }`,
106:   })
107:   return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
108: }

110: function sporeField(count, color, radius, height, size) {
111:   const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
112:   const seeds = []
113:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
114:     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
115:     const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * radius
116:     const y = Math.random() * height
117:     positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
118:     positions[i * 3 + 1] = y
119:     positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
120:     seeds.push({ speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.35, phase: Math.random() * 10, a })
121:   }
122:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
123:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
124:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color, size, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true })
125:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
126:   points.userData.seeds = seeds
127:   return points
128: }

82:   for (const gene of GENES) {

87:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
88:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
89:     if (bias._wild) {
90:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
91:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
92:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
93:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
94:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
95:         : [r(), r()]
96:     } else {
97:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]

585:   battleLunge(who, cb) {
586:     if (!this.fighters) return
587:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
588:     const start = who === 'player' ? this.playerStart : this.foeStart
589:     const dir = who === 'player' ? 1.6 : -1.6
590:     const t0 = performance.now()
591:     const dur = 320
592:     const tick = () => {
593:       const k = (performance.now() - t0) / dur
594:       if (k >= 1) { mesh.position.x = start.x; if (cb) cb(); return }
595:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI)
596:       mesh.position.x = start.x + dir * e
597:       mesh.position.z = start.z - (who === 'player' ? 0.8 : 0.8) * e
598:       requestAnimationFrame(tick)
599:     }
600:     tick()
601:   }

603:   hitReact(who, done) {
604:     if (!this.fighters) { done?.(); return }
605:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
606:     mesh.userData.flash?.('#ff7a6b', 0.22)
607:     this.shake(0.22)
608:     const start = mesh.position.clone()
609:     const t0 = performance.now()
610:     const tick = () => {
611:       if (this.fighters?.[who] !== mesh) return
612:       const k = (performance.now() - t0) / 300
613:       if (k >= 1) { mesh.position.copy(start); done?.(); return }
614:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI) * 0.24
615:       mesh.position.x = start.x + (who === 'player' ? -e : e)
616:       requestAnimationFrame(tick)
617:     }
618:     tick()
619:     this.burst({ x: mesh.position.x, y: 1.05, z: mesh.position.z }, who === 'player' ? '#ff7a6b' : '#ffd27a', 26)
620:   }

622:   faint(who) {
623:     if (!this.fighters) return
624:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
625:     const start = { x: mesh.position.x, y: mesh.position.y, z: mesh.position.z, rotation: mesh.rotation.z }
626:     const direction = who === 'player' ? 1 : -1
627:     const t0 = performance.now()
628:     const tick = () => {
629:       if (this.fighters?.[who] !== mesh) return
630:       const k = clamp((performance.now() - t0) / 700, 0, 1)
631:       const ease = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3
632:       mesh.rotation.z = start.rotation + direction * ease * 1.12
633:       mesh.position.x = start.x + direction * ease * 0.18
634:       mesh.position.y = start.y - ease * 0.3
635:       if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick)
636:     }
637:     this.burst({ x: start.x, y: 1.05, z: start.z }, '#ffd27a', 30)
638:     tick()
639:   }

641:   burst(pos, color = '#ffffff', count = 24) {
642:     if (!this.bursts) {
643:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
644:       const max = 600
645:       const positions = new Float32Array(max * 3)
646:       const colors = new Float32Array(max * 3)
647:       positions.fill(9999)
648:       geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
649:       geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3))
650:       const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 0.16, vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending })
651:       this.burstPoints = new THREE.Points(geo, material)
652:       this.burstPoints.frustumCulled = false
653:       this.scene.add(this.burstPoints)
654:       this.burstState = { next: 0, max, life: new Float32Array(max), vel: new Float32Array(max * 3), color: new Float32Array(max * 3) }
655:     }
656:     const st = this.burstState
657:     const c = new THREE.Color(color)
658:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
659:       const idx = st.next
660:       st.next = (st.next + 1) % st.max
661:       st.life[idx] = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5
662:       st.vel[idx * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3.4
663:       st.vel[idx * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * 3.2 + 0.4
664:       st.vel[idx * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.6
665:       const pos3 = this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.array
666:       pos3[idx * 3] = pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
667:       pos3[idx * 3 + 1] = pos.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
668:       pos3[idx * 3 + 2] = pos.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
669:       const col = this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.color.array
670:       col[idx * 3] = c.r; col[idx * 3 + 1] = c.g; col[idx * 3 + 2] = c.b
671:     }
672:     this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
673:     this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true
674:   }

680:   bindPointer() {
681:     const el = this.renderer.domElement
682:     const down = e => {
683:       this.pointer.down = true
684:       this.pointer.moved = 0
685:       this.pointer.x = e.clientX
686:       this.pointer.y = e.clientY
687:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
688:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
689:       this.autoRotate = false
690:       el.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
691:     }
692:     const move = e => {
693:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
694:       const dx = e.clientX - this.pointer.lx
695:       const dy = e.clientY - this.pointer.ly
696:       this.pointer.moved += Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy)
697:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
698:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
699:       this.orbit.yaw -= dx * 0.006
700:       this.orbit.pitch = clamp(this.orbit.pitch + dy * 0.004, 0.02, 0.95)
701:     }
702:     const up = e => {
703:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
704:       this.pointer.down = false
705:       if (this.pointer.moved < 8) this.pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY)
706:       if (this.mode === 'habitat') this.autoRotate = true
707:     }
708:     el.addEventListener('pointerdown', down)
709:     el.addEventListener('pointermove', move)
710:     el.addEventListener('pointerup', up)
711:     el.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { this.pointer.down = false })
712:     el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
713:       e.preventDefault()
714:       this.orbit.radius = clamp(this.orbit.radius + e.deltaY * 0.006, 6.5, 15)
715:     }, { passive: false })
716:   }
717: 
718:   pickAt(clientX, clientY) {
719:     if (this.mode !== 'habitat') return
720:     const rect = this.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect()
721:     this.ndc.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1
722:     this.ndc.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
723:     this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this.ndc, this.camera)
724:     const hits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.habitat.children, true)
725:     for (const hit of hits) {
726:       let o = hit.object
727:       while (o && !o.userData.creatureId) o = o.parent
728:       if (o?.userData.creatureId) {
729:         this.hooks.onSelect?.(o.userData.creatureId)
730:         return
731:       }
732:     }
733:     this.hooks.onBackground?.()
734:   }

744:   loop() {
745:     this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop())
746:     const dt = Math.min(0.05, this.clock.getDelta())
747:     this.time += dt
748: 
749:     if (this.mode === 'habitat') {
750:       this.updateHabitat(dt)
751:     } else {
752:       this.updateArena(dt)
753:     }
754: 
755:     this.updateParticles(dt)
756: 
757:     const orbit = this.orbit
758:     if (this.autoRotate && this.mode === 'habitat') {
759:       this.orbitYaw = (this.orbitYaw ?? orbit.yaw) + dt * 0.028
760:       orbit.yaw = this.orbitYaw
761:     }
762:     const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, orbit.targetY, 0)
763:     const dist = orbit.radius
764:     const camX = Math.sin(orbit.yaw) * Math.cos(orbit.pitch) * dist
765:     const camZ = Math.cos(orbit.yaw) * Math.cos(orbit.pitch) * dist
766:     const camY = orbit.targetY + Math.sin(orbit.pitch) * dist + 0.4
767:     this.camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(camX, camY, camZ), 0.08)
768:     if (this.shakeAmt > 0.001) {
769:       this.camera.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shakeAmt
770:       this.camera.position.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shakeAmt
771:       this.shakeAmt *= 0.9
772:     }
773:     this.camera.lookAt(target)
774: 
775:     // slow toggling details
776:     if (this.isles) for (const isle of this.isles) {
777:       isle.position.y = isle.userData.baseY + Math.sin(this.time * 0.5 + isle.userData.phase) * 0.25
778:       isle.rotation.y += dt * 0.05
779:     }
780:     if (this.arena.visible && this.arenaBeams) this.arenaBeams.rotation.y += dt * 0.03
781:     if (this.p1Ring) {
782:       const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(this.time * 2.4) * 0.07
783:       this.p1Ring.scale.setScalar(pulse)
784:       this.p2Ring.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.sin(this.time * 2.4 + 1.6) * 0.07)
785:     }
786: 
787:     this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera)
788:   }

790:   updateHabitat(dt) {
791:     const list = [...this.creatures.values()]
792:     for (const entry of list) {
793:       if (!this.habitat.children.includes(entry.root)) continue
794:       entry.pause -= dt
795:       const dx = entry.target.x - entry.root.position.x
796:       const dz = entry.target.z - entry.root.position.z
797:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
798:       let moving = 0
799:       if (entry.pause <= 0) {
800:         if (dist < 0.25) {
801:           entry.pause = 2 + Math.random() * 5
802:           const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
803:           const r = 1.5 + Math.random() * 4.8
804:           entry.target.set(Math.cos(a) * r, 0, Math.sin(a) * r)
805:         } else {
806:           moving = 1
807:           const step = Math.min(dist, entry.speed * dt)
808:           entry.root.position.x += (dx / dist) * step
809:           entry.root.position.z += (dz / dist) * step
810:           const want = Math.atan2(dx, dz)
811:           let diff = want - entry.root.rotation.y
812:           while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2
813:           while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2
814:           entry.root.rotation.y += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 4)
815:         }
816:       }

844:       arr[i * 3] += Math.sin(this.time * 0.5 + s.phase) * dt * 0.12
845:       arr[i * 3 + 2] += Math.cos(this.time * 0.4 + s.phase) * dt * 0.1
846:       if (arr[i * 3 + 1] > 5.8) arr[i * 3 + 1] = 0.1

92:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
93:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
94:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
95:         : [r(), r()]
96:     } else {
97:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]
98:     }
99:   }
100:   return genome
101: }
102: 
103: // Phenotype: average expression; a few genes skew dominant to create variety.
104: export function phenotype(genome) {
105:   const p = {}
106:   for (const gene of GENES) {
107:     // Older local saves predate newer appearance genes; keep them playable.
108:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome[gene.key] || []
109:     p[gene.key] = (a + b) / 2
110:   }
111:   // Quantized expressed physical genes make morphology reproducible and
112:   // heritable while allowing allele edits and breeding to reshuffle the form.
113:   let morphologyHash = 2166136261
114:   for (const key of MORPHOLOGY_KEYS) {
115:     morphologyHash ^= Math.round(clamp(p[key]) * 255)
116:     morphologyHash = Math.imul(morphologyHash, 16777619)
117:   }
118:   const morphologyIndex = (morphologyHash >>> 0) % 100
119:   // Derived composite values used by the mesh builder.
120:   const size = p.size
121:   p.height = 0.72 + size * 0.62 + p.legs * 0.18
122:   p.huePrimary = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueA))
123:   p.hueAccent = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueB))
124:   p.sat = Math.round(38 + p.pattern * 34 + p.muscle * 10)
125:   p.lightness = Math.round(52 - p.bone * 12 + p.eyes * 4)
126:   p.bodyColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary} ${p.sat}% ${p.lightness}%)`
127:   p.accentColor = `hsl(${p.hueAccent} ${Math.min(92, p.sat + 18)}% ${58 + p.eyes * 8}%)`
128:   p.darkColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary - 12} ${p.sat + 6}% ${Math.max(18, p.lightness - 26)}%)`
129:   p.eyeColor = `hsl(${(p.hueAccent + 38) % 360} 100% ${62 + p.brain * 10}%)`
130:   p.speciesType = ['Drake', 'Mireling', 'Skykin', 'Goliath'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))]
131:   p.skinType = ['Velvet hide', 'Scaled hide', 'Plated hide', 'Crystal hide'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.hide * 4))]
132:   p.postureName = p.posture > 0.58 ? 'Upright' : 'Grounded'
133:   const bodyPlanIndex = Math.min(BODY_PLANS.length - 1, Math.floor(p.bodyPlan * BODY_PLANS.length))
134:   p.bodyPlanKey = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].key
135:   p.bodyPlanName = BODY_PLANS[bodyPlanIndex].label
136:   p.morphologyIndex = morphologyIndex
137:   p.morphologyFamily = Math.floor(morphologyIndex / 10)
138:   p.morphologyVariant = morphologyIndex % 10
139:   p.morphologyName = `${MORPHOLOGY_FAMILIES[p.morphologyFamily]} ${String(p.morphologyVariant + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
140:   p.skinRoughness = 0.9 - p.hide * 0.62
141:   p.horniness = p.horns
142:   p.limbCount = { fish: 0, insect: 6, bird: 2, quadruped: 4, biped: 2 }[p.bodyPlanKey]
143:   p.tuskSize = clamp(p.tusks)
144:   p.maneSize = clamp(p.mane)
145:   p.biolum = clamp(p.biolum)
146:   p.glowColor = `hsl(${(p.hueAccent + 90) % 360} 90% ${50 + p.brain * 20}%)`
147:   return p
148: }

150: // ─── stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
151: export const STAT_KEYS = ['power', 'bones', 'mobility', 'muscle', 'brain', 'condition']
152: export const STAT_META = {
153:   power:    { label: 'Ability',  color: '#d8ff5f', short: 'PWR' },
154:   bones:    { label: 'Bones',    color: '#ffd36e', short: 'BON' },
155:   mobility: { label: 'Mobility', color: '#67e8f9', short: 'MOB' },
156:   muscle:   { label: 'Muscle',   color: '#ff8a7a', short: 'MUS' },
157:   brain:    { label: 'Brain',    color: '#c4a7ff', short: 'BRN' },
158:   condition:{ label: 'Condition',color: '#8fffc0', short: 'CON' },
159: }

161: export function averageNeeds(needs) {
162:   return (needs.hunger + needs.energy + needs.hygiene + needs.fun) / 4
163: }
164: 
165: export function heterozygosity(genome) {
166:   let sum = 0
167:   for (const gene of GENES) {
168:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome?.[gene.key] || []
169:     sum += Math.abs(a - b)
170:   }
171:   return sum / GENES.length
172: }
173: 
174: export function conditionOf(creature) {
175:   if (!creature) return 0
176:   const needs = creature.needs
177:   const vitality = averageNeeds(needs)
178:   const vigor = clamp01(heterozygosity(creature.genome) * 1.8) * 9
179:   const levelBonus = Math.min(6, (creature.wins || 0) * 0.8)
180:   const raw = vitality * 0.88 + vigor + levelBonus + 4
181:   return Math.round(clamp(raw, 4, 100))
182: }

184: export function statsOf(creature) {
185:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
186:   const cond = conditionOf(creature)
187:   const condMul = 0.72 + (cond / 100) * 0.28
188:   const raw = {
189:     power: 12 + p.size * 18 + p.muscle * 30 + p.bone * 14 + p.horns * 12 + p.snout * 6 + p.armor * 7 + p.tusks * 10,
190:     bones: 8 + p.bone * 84 + p.armor * 8,
191:     mobility: 8 + p.legs * 25 + p.speed * 32 + (1 - p.stance) * 12 + p.wings * 14 - p.size * 7,
192:     muscle: 6 + p.muscle * 88 + p.stance * 6,
193:     brain: 5 + p.brain * 88 + p.eyes * 7,
194:     condition: cond,
195:   }
196:   const out = {}
197:   for (const k of STAT_KEYS) out[k] = Math.round(clamp(k === 'condition' ? raw[k] : raw[k] * condMul, 3, 100))
198:   return out
199: }

201: export function maxHpOf(creature) {
202:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
203:   const stats = statsOf(creature)
204:   return Math.round(64 + p.size * 58 + p.bone * 34 + stats.muscle * 0.28 + p.armor * 16 + (creature.wins || 0) * 3)
205: }

208:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
209:   return Math.round(58 + p.speed * 34 + p.legs * 18 + p.brain * 10 + p.wings * 10)

213:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
214:   return {
215:     hunger: 0.24 + p.metabolism * 0.33 + p.size * 0.13,
216:     energy: 0.10 + p.speed * 0.12 + p.size * 0.06 + p.wings * 0.05,
217:     hygiene: 0.05 + p.armor * 0.04 + p.pattern * 0.05,
218:     fun: 0.07 + p.brain * 0.15 + p.speed * 0.04,

222: export function decayNeeds(creature, seconds) {
223:   const rate = needsProfile(creature)
224:   for (const k of ['hunger', 'energy', 'hygiene', 'fun']) {
225:     creature.needs[k] = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, creature.needs[k] - rate[k] * seconds))
226:   }

252:     id: 'gore', name: 'Horn Rush', icon: '⛏', type: 'strike', cost: 18,
253:     power: 1.08 + p.horns * 0.52 + p.bone * 0.25,

255:     desc: 'Lower the crown and charge. Huge damage, less accurate.',
256:     fx: 'gore', crit: 0.1 + p.horns * 0.14,

294: // ─── breeding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
295: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
296:   let sum = 0
297:   for (const gene of GENES) {
298:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
299:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
300:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
301:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
302:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
303:   }
304:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
305: }
306: 
307: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
308:   const child = {}
309:   const mutations = []
310:   for (const gene of GENES) {
311:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
312:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
313:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
314:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
315:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
316:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
317:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
318:       mutations.push(gene.key)
319:     }
320:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
321:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
322:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
323:     }
324:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
325:   }
326:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
327: }
328: 
329: const FIRST = ['Vex', 'Morrow', 'Thal', 'Kestrel', 'Nyra', 'Orin', 'Sable', 'Quill', 'Rime', 'Ash', 'Bramble', 'Cinder', 'Dusk', 'Echo', 'Fen', 'Gloam', 'Harrow', 'Iris', 'Juno', 'Kite', 'Lumen', 'Moss', 'Nettle', 'Onyx', 'Pyre', 'Rook', 'Silt', 'Thorn', 'Umber', 'Vale', 'Wisp', 'Yarrow', 'Zephyr', 'Cobalt', 'Dune', 'Ember', 'Flint', 'Gale', 'Hazel', 'Indigo', 'Jasper', 'Kelp', 'Lark', 'Mica', 'Nimbus', 'Opal', 'Pearl', 'Reed', 'Slate', 'Tide']
330: const SECOND = ['back', 'wing', 'maw', 'horn', 'crest', 'shade', 'spine', 'bloom', 'stride', 'gaze', 'fang', 'scale', 'song', 'tread', 'vault', 'whisper', 'cradle', 'howl', 'drift', 'spark']
331: 
332: export function makeName(genome, parents) {
333:   const p = phenotype(genome)
334:   const first = FIRST[Math.floor(Math.random() * FIRST.length)]
335:   let epithet = SECOND[Math.floor(Math.random() * SECOND.length)]
336:   if (p.horns > 0.65) epithet = 'horn'
337:   else if (p.wings > 0.6) epithet = 'wing'
338:   else if (p.brain > 0.7) epithet = 'gaze'
339:   else if (p.speed > 0.68) epithet = 'stride'
340:   else if (p.armor > 0.65) epithet = 'scale'
341:   const name = `${first}${epithet}`
342:   return name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1)
343: }
344: 
345: export function sexOf() {
346:   return Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'F' : 'M'
347: }
348: 
349: export function generateStarter(seed, bias) {
350:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, bias), seed)
351: }
352: 
353: export function generateWild(seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000)) {
354:   return createCreature(randomGenome(seed, { _wild: true }), seed)
355: }
356: 
357: function createCreature(genome, seed) {
358:   return {
359:     id: cryptoId(),
360:     name: makeName(genome),
361:     genome,
362:     sex: seed % 2 === 0 ? 'F' : 'M',
363:     needs: freshNeeds(86),
364:     wins: 0,
365:     battles: 0,
366:     born: Date.now(),
367:     generation: 0,
368:   }
369: }
370: 
371: let idCounter = 0
372: export function cryptoId() {
373:   idCounter++
374:   return 'c' + Date.now().toString(36) + idCounter.toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)
375: }
376: 
377: export function dnaSequence(genome) {
378:   const bases = 'ACGT'
379:   let seq = ''
380:   for (const gene of GENES) {
381:     const alleles = genome?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
382:     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
383:       const n = Math.floor(clamp(alleles[i] ?? 0.5) * 4095)
384:       for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) seq += bases[(n >> (j * 2)) & 3]
385:     }
386:     seq += '·'
387:   }
388:   return seq.slice(0, -1)
389: }
390: 
391: export function formatAge(born) {
392:   const s = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - born) / 1000)
393:   if (s < 90) return `${Math.floor(s)}s`
394:   if (s < 5400) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m`
395:   if (s < 86400 * 2) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h`
396:   return `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d`
397: }

585:   battleLunge(who, cb) {
586:     if (!this.fighters) return
587:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
588:     const start = who === 'player' ? this.playerStart : this.foeStart
589:     const dir = who === 'player' ? 1.6 : -1.6
590:     const t0 = performance.now()
591:     const dur = 320
592:     const tick = () => {
593:       const k = (performance.now() - t0) / dur
594:       if (k >= 1) { mesh.position.x = start.x; if (cb) cb(); return }
595:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI)
596:       mesh.position.x = start.x + dir * e
597:       mesh.position.z = start.z - (who === 'player' ? 0.8 : 0.8) * e
598:       requestAnimationFrame(tick)
599:     }
600:     tick()
601:   }

603:   hitReact(who, done) {
604:     if (!this.fighters) { done?.(); return }
605:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
606:     mesh.userData.flash?.('#ff7a6b', 0.22)
607:     this.shake(0.22)
608:     const start = mesh.position.clone()
609:     const t0 = performance.now()
610:     const tick = () => {
611:       if (this.fighters?.[who] !== mesh) return
612:       const k = (performance.now() - t0) / 300
613:       if (k >= 1) { mesh.position.copy(start); done?.(); return }
614:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI) * 0.24
615:       mesh.position.x = start.x + (who === 'player' ? -e : e)
616:       requestAnimationFrame(tick)
617:     }
618:     tick()
619:     this.burst({ x: mesh.position.x, y: 1.05, z: mesh.position.z }, who === 'player' ? '#ff7a6b' : '#ffd27a', 26)
620:   }

622:   faint(who) {
623:     if (!this.fighters) return
624:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
625:     const start = { x: mesh.position.x, y: mesh.position.y, z: mesh.position.z, rotation: mesh.rotation.z }
626:     const direction = who === 'player' ? 1 : -1
627:     const t0 = performance.now()
628:     const tick = () => {
629:       if (this.fighters?.[who] !== mesh) return
630:       const k = clamp((performance.now() - t0) / 700, 0, 1)
631:       const ease = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3
632:       mesh.rotation.z = start.rotation + direction * ease * 1.12
633:       mesh.position.x = start.x + direction * ease * 0.18
634:       mesh.position.y = start.y - ease * 0.3
635:       if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick)
636:     }
637:     this.burst({ x: start.x, y: 1.05, z: start.z }, '#ffd27a', 30)
638:     tick()
639:   }

641:   burst(pos, color = '#ffffff', count = 24) {
642:     if (!this.bursts) {
643:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
644:       const max = 600
645:       const positions = new Float32Array(max * 3)
646:       const colors = new Float32Array(max * 3)
647:       positions.fill(9999)
648:       geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
649:       geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3))
650:       const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 0.16, vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending })
651:       this.burstPoints = new THREE.Points(geo, material)
652:       this.burstPoints.frustumCulled = false
653:       this.scene.add(this.burstPoints)
654:       this.burstState = { next: 0, max, life: new Float32Array(max), vel: new Float32Array(max * 3), color: new Float32Array(max * 3) }
655:     }
656:     const st = this.burstState
657:     const c = new THREE.Color(color)
658:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
659:       const idx = st.next
660:       st.next = (st.next + 1) % st.max
661:       st.life[idx] = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5
662:       st.vel[idx * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3.4
663:       st.vel[idx * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * 3.2 + 0.4
664:       st.vel[idx * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.6
665:       const pos3 = this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.array
666:       pos3[idx * 3] = pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
667:       pos3[idx * 3 + 1] = pos.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
668:       pos3[idx * 3 + 2] = pos.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
669:       const col = this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.color.array
670:       col[idx * 3] = c.r; col[idx * 3 + 1] = c.g; col[idx * 3 + 2] = c.b
671:     }
672:     this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
673:     this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true
674:   }

680:   bindPointer() {
681:     const el = this.renderer.domElement
682:     const down = e => {
683:       this.pointer.down = true
684:       this.pointer.moved = 0
685:       this.pointer.x = e.clientX
686:       this.pointer.y = e.clientY
687:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
688:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
689:       this.autoRotate = false
690:       el.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
691:     }
692:     const move = e => {
693:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
694:       const dx = e.clientX - this.pointer.lx
695:       const dy = e.clientY - this.pointer.ly
696:       this.pointer.moved += Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy)
697:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
698:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY

295: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
296:   let sum = 0
297:   for (const gene of GENES) {
298:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
299:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
300:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
301:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
302:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
303:   }
304:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
305: }

307: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
308:   const child = {}
309:   const mutations = []
310:   for (const gene of GENES) {
311:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
312:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
313:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
314:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
315:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
316:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
317:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
318:       mutations.push(gene.key)
319:     }
320:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
321:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
322:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
323:     }
324:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
325:   }
326:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
327: }

595:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI)
596:       mesh.position.x = start.x + dir * e

680:   bindPointer() {
681:     const el = this.renderer.domElement
682:     const down = e => {
683:       this.pointer.down = true
684:       this.pointer.moved = 0
685:       this.pointer.x = e.clientX
686:       this.pointer.y = e.clientY
687:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
688:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
689:       this.autoRotate = false
690:       el.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
691:     }
692:     const move = e => {
693:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
694:       const dx = e.clientX - this.pointer.lx
695:       const dy = e.clientY - this.pointer.ly
696:       this.pointer.moved += Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy)
697:       this.pointer.lx = e.clientX
698:       this.pointer.ly = e.clientY
699:       this.orbit.yaw -= dx * 0.006
700:       this.orbit.pitch = clamp(this.orbit.pitch + dy * 0.004, 0.02, 0.95)
701:     }
702:     const up = e => {
703:       if (!this.pointer.down) return
704:       this.pointer.down = false
705:       if (this.pointer.moved < 8) this.pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY)
706:       if (this.mode === 'habitat') this.autoRotate = true
707:     }
708:     el.addEventListener('pointerdown', down)
709:     el.addEventListener('pointermove', move)
710:     el.addEventListener('pointerup', up)
711:     el.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { this.pointer.down = false })
712:     el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
713:       e.preventDefault()
714:       this.orbit.radius = clamp(this.orbit.radius + e.deltaY * 0.006, 6.5, 15)
715:     }, { passive: false })
716:   }

718:   pickAt(clientX, clientY) {
719:     if (this.mode !== 'habitat') return
720:     const rect = this.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect()
721:     this.ndc.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1
722:     this.ndc.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
723:     this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this.ndc, this.camera)
724:     const hits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.habitat.children, true)
725:     for (const hit of hits) {
726:       let o = hit.object
727:       while (o && !o.userData.creatureId) o = o.parent
728:       if (o?.userData.creatureId) {
729:         this.hooks.onSelect?.(o.userData.creatureId)
730:         return
731:       }
732:     }
733:     this.hooks.onBackground?.()
734:   }

744:   loop() {
745:     this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop())
746:     const dt = Math.min(0.05, this.clock.getDelta())
747:     this.time += dt
748: 
749:     if (this.mode === 'habitat') {
750:       this.updateHabitat(dt)
751:     } else {
752:       this.updateArena(dt)
753:     }
754: 
755:     this.updateParticles(dt)
756: 
757:     const orbit = this.orbit
758:     if (this.autoRotate && this.mode === 'habitat') {
759:       this.orbitYaw = (this.orbitYaw ?? orbit.yaw) + dt * 0.028
760:       orbit.yaw = this.orbitYaw
761:     }
762:     const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, orbit.targetY, 0)
763:     const dist = orbit.radius
764:     const camX = Math.sin(orbit.yaw) * Math.cos(orbit.pitch) * dist

593:   function update(dt, movement = 0) {
594:     t += dt

597:     bodyGroup.scale.set(1 + breathe * 0.4, 1 + breathe, 1 + breathe * 0.3)

599:     neckBase.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.1) * 0.04 - 0.04 + walkAmt * 0.06
600:     headGroup.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.4 + 0.7) * 0.05

602:     headGroup.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.02

604:     tailSegs.forEach((seg, i) => {
605:       seg.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.4) * 0.12 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.05
606:       seg.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.2 + 0.6) * 0.035
607:     })
608:     for (let i = 0; i < wings.length; i++) {
609:       const side = i === 0 ? -1 : 1
610:       wings[i].rotation.z = side * (0.12 + Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 0.18) + side * walkAmt * 0.12
611:       wings[i].rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 0.06
612:     }
613:     for (const leg of legs) {
614:       const phase = walkAmt > 0.02 ? Math.sin(t * 7.5 + leg.phase) : 0
615:       leg.group.rotation.x = (leg.front ? 0.06 : -0.06) + phase * 0.5 * walkAmt
616:       leg.knee.rotation.x = Math.max(0, -phase) * 0.6 * walkAmt
617:     }
618:     for (const arm of arms) {
619:       arm.group.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 7.5 + (arm.side < 0 ? Math.PI : 0)) * 0.16 * walkAmt
620:     }
621:     if (flashTime > 0) {
622:       flashTime -= dt
623:       const k = Math.max(0, flashTime / 0.18)
624:       for (const b of baseEmissive) {
625:         if (!b.e) continue
626:         b.m.emissive.copy(b.e).lerp(flashColor, k)
627:         b.m.emissiveIntensity = b.i + k * 2.4
628:       }
629:     }
630:   }

634:     flashTime = duration

640:     })

642:     root.removeFromParent()
643:   }
